messages:
mina: opened a docs PR to clarify Optimize toolkit behavior around prefetch vs KV cache. includes migration note + sdk snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 :wave:
raj: dropping in. quick q — did you change the default prefetch window? that's in the perf table.
lina: saw a dead link in samples that points to an old gist. i can patch it in the PR if you want @mina.
mina: pls do @lina, thanks. @raj runtime default unchanged (0.5s heuristic) but wording implied otherwise. updated wording + note on how to override.
ezra: can you paste the SDK snippet here so i can confirm param names?
mina: snippet is in the PR but copying: ```
# python example
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient(prefetch_ms=500, kv_cache=True)
# prefetch_ms: how long to warm KV (ms)
# kv_cache: enable prefix/KV cache
```
raj: nit — current SDK on main uses `prefetch_window_ms` as the arg. runtime renamed earlier. i'll open a tiny compat PR to add alias and ping sdk owner.
lina: link fix PR incoming from me now. will replace gist with samples dir link.
mina: can someone sanity check the migration blurb under "When to tune prefetch and batching"? i recommend heuristics for short vs long seqs but want a second pair of eyes.
ezra: reading — add explicit short-seq (<32 tokens) example recommending batch_size=4 and prefetch_ms=100; also include the p50/p95 numbers from the microbench.
mina: good idea. i'll add numbers and a small png graph in the PR.
raj: also add a one-line note that quantized models can affect KV hit-rate (small but useful callout).
lina: link PR merged, ci passed :white_check_mark:
mina: added numbers, quantization callout, and a note about the sdk param alias. pushed.
docs-bot: CI: docs build success for PR #4321 — 9 warnings (link-check), 0 errors.
raj: i'll do a quick code review. if clean i'll merge and schedule for tomorrow's docs deploy.
ezra: nice cleanup team! :smile:
mina: thanks all. assigning followups in PR for sdk + runtime owners.
